samples.question: The image is divided by thin lines into four quadrants: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Each quadrant contains one light-gray filled disk with a small dark dot at the disk's center. Exactly one of the four disks has its dark dot displaced clearly away from the center (off-center); the other three disks have their dot exactly at the disk center. Which quadrant contains the disk whose dark dot is off-center? Answer with the quadrant name.
